state.contextHint: Static assets only. Source = committed src/assets/icons/icon-512x512.png. Generator script lives in the scratchpad and is never committed; nothing added to package.json. Run builds/tests pinned to 2 cores (taskset -c 0,1, NG_BUILD_MAX_WORKERS=2). Colors and app names stay unchanged.

T001.description: Write a one-off icon generator in the session scratchpad (never committed): npx sharp crops and resizes src/assets/icons/icon-512x512.png, and a minimal Node ICO writer packs PNG payloads. No package.json change.

T002.description: Generate src/favicon.ico as a real ICO with 16/32/48px PNG images, tightly cropped so the shell fills the frame and the bottom cut sits on the image edge; `file` must report 3 icons.

T003.description: Generate src/assets/icons/apple-touch-icon.png (180x180) and icon-maskable-{192x192,512x512}.png (navy background, shell at about 70% of the canvas, cropped so no straight cut edge shows).

completion.notes: FR-004 says the shell fits the ~80% safe zone; with the cut flush to the bottom edge, a circular mask trims the shell's lower edge along a curve (apex and sides stay inside).

T004.description: Wire the icons: add <link rel="apple-touch-icon"> in src/index.html; in src/manifest.webmanifest set the existing icons to "purpose": "any" and add separate "maskable" entries for the 192/512 maskable icons.

T005.description: Remove the duplicate <link rel="manifest"> and <meta name="theme-color"> from src/index.html (exactly one of each remains; theme_color and names unchanged).

T006.description: Delete the untracked root shell_icon512.png; run ng build (check dist/ holds favicon.ico, apple-touch-icon.png, both maskable icons) and ng test; check the DevTools maskable preview; post a fresh-context 16px tab screenshot on #8 for approval.
